rows.en:
{C:8190B102}{C:81958296D32A00000000}Master,
what are you thinking?

{C:8190C001}{C:81958296D52A00000000}My thoughts?
Now, what a strange thing to ask.

{C:8190B202}{C:81958296D62A00000000}Don't play dumb.
{C:819782830400}Yoja Soldiers{C:819782830000} have sent us a report.

{C:8190C001}{C:81958296D72A00000000}If you've something to say,
why not say it plainly,
like a man?

{C:81958296D82A00000000}Oh, but you esteemed Four Masho are demon generals,
so perhaps you aren't men at all.


{x00}

rows.en:
{C:8193B402}{C:81958296DA2A00000000}You dare mock us?!

{C:8193B102}{C:81958296DB2A00000000}Stop, {C:819782830400}Rajura{C:819782830000}!
There's no point in fighting among ourselves.

{C:8193B302}{C:81958296DD2A00000000}Comrades?
You call this old geezer a comrade!?
He's a mere human!

{C:8193B102}{C:81958296DE2A00000000}{C:819782830400}Naza{C:819782830000}, you stop too.


{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296E52A00000000}Are those people in costumes?
They're really well made.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296E62A00000000}They are! They're adorable!!

{C:8190B801}{C:81958296D20000000000}When all's said and done,
you're still a girl, Nelfea.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296E72A00000000}What's wrong with that?
Cute things are cute!


{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81900300}{C:81958296ED2A00000000}Eee!
They're coming this way!

{C:81900400}{C:81958296EE2A00000000}You certainly look happy.

{C:8190C802}{C:81958296EF2A00000000}Have you seen our leader around here?
He's a boy in red clothes
with his belly showing.

{C:8190AB02}{C:81958296F02A00000000}Rie, that's not a costume.
That's a living creature.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296F12A00000000}Whaaaaat!!

{C:8190C702}{C:81958296F22A00000000}I'm sorry to startle you.
We're called Animanoids,
and we're genuine living organisms.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296F32A00000000}Whew... Just what is going on
with this world...?


{C:8190AA02}{C:81958296F42A00000000}I don't think we've met
the person you call your leader.

{C:8190C802}{C:81958296F62A00000000}I see. Where the heck have
our leader and the others gone?

{C:8190C902}{C:81958296F72A00000000}They're a handful.
So, what do we do?

{C:8190C702}{C:81958296F82A00000000}Don't you sense something strange?

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296F92A00000000}Can't you tell anything
with your Trooper abilities?

{C:8190AD02}{C:81958296FA2A00000000}It's the Yoja!
Rie, all of you, stand back!
Ryo, we're armoring up!



{x00}

rows.en:
{C:8190C602}{C:81958296FB2A00000000}So there are enemies like that here.
But we can't fight
without becoming Kiba.

{C:8190C702}{C:81958296FC2A00000000}We need to rejoin Toya and the others
as soon as possible.

{C:8190C802}{C:81958296FD2A00000000}So, what do we do?

{C:8190C602}{C:81958296FF2A00000000}You people in armor,
could you allow us
to accompany you?

{C:8190AE02}{C:81958296002B00000000}Accompany us?

{C:8190C702}{C:81958296012B00000000}You clearly don't seem to be
from this continent.

{C:81958296022B00000000}So I believe you must have
some means of transportation.
Is that correct?

{C:8190AC02}{C:81958296032B00000000}So that's why you want to come with us.
What do we do?

{C:8190C902}{C:81958296052B00000000}Tch, it's pathetic that we can't do anything
without relying on people like these.

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296072B00000000}Then you don't have to
force yourselves
to come with us.

{C:8190C902}{C:81958296092B00000000}What did you say!!

{C:81900400}{C:819582960A2B00000000}Oh, stop it already!
I'm sick of quarrels
whenever someone new turns up!

{C:819582960B2B00000000}You bears, make up your minds.
Are you coming with us or not?

{C:8190C902}{C:819582960C2B00000000}B-bears?

{C:8190B801}{C:81958296D30000000000}Yeah, yeah!

{C:81900400}{C:819582960D2B00000000}Don't heckle from the sidelines!!

{C:8190B801}{C:81958296D40000000000}I'm sorry...

{C:81900300}{C:819582960E2B00000000}We can make arrangements
to take you aboard our ship.
What would you like to do?

{C:8190C802}{C:81958296102B00000000}We've gotta
find our leader.

{C:8190C702}{C:81958296112B00000000}There's only one answer, then.

{C:8190C602}{C:81958296132B00000000}We'd like you to
let us aboard your ship.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296142B00000000}Yes, we'd be delighted.







{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296E22900000000}What do you think you're doing!?

{C:8190D400}{C:81958296E32900000000}A little brat like you
has no business looking at Proto One.
Get lost!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296E42900000000}You hit me out of nowhere,
and now you're saying that!!

{C:8190D400}{C:81958296E52900000000}What was that, brat?
You dare defy me!!


{C:8190C900}{C:81958296E62900000000}Epsilon!
What are you doing!!

{C:8190D400}{C:81958296E72900000000}Well, this brat was looking at Proto One...

{C:8190C900}{C:81958296E82900000000}I'll take care of things here.
You go back ahead of me.

{C:8190D400}{C:81958296E92900000000}If you say so, Proto One...

{C:8190C900}{C:81958296EB2900000000}I'm sorry.
He's a little hotheaded.
I'm Fyana.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296EC2900000000}Huh?
Didn't that person just
call you Proto One?

{C:8190C900}{C:81958296ED2900000000}That's...

{C:81930100}{C:81958296EE2900000000}Oh!
Fyana is the same name
as the person Chirico's looking for.

{C:8190C900}{C:81958296EF2900000000}You know Chirico!?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296F02900000000}So it is you.
Come with me.
Chirico's waiting.

{C:8190C900}{C:81958296F12900000000}I... I can't go now.
Don't tell Chirico you met me.
I'm sorry...


{x00}

{C:81930100}{C:81958296B33300000000}This is called the Mobile Trace System,
isn't it?

{C:81958296B43300000000}With this, it almost seems
even I could operate it.

{C:8190B601}{C:81958296B53300000000}It's not that simple.
I tried getting in it once...


{x00}

{C:8190B601}{C:81958296073800000000}And it was awful, I tell you!

{C:81958296083800000000}You're solidly built,
but you have a delicate frame, so I don't think you could do it.
You really need to be a martial artist.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296B63300000000}I was a little interested,
but hearing that scares me.
Hmm, I'll give it up.

{C:8190B601}{C:81958296B73300000000}Good. You listen to reason.




{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81908400}{C:81958296223400000000}Kamille, listen to me.
It's dangerous to keep her at your side.
Amuro says so too.

{C:81908200}{C:81958296243400000000}Lieutenant Quattro,
can't you speak without
borrowing Amuro's words?

{C:81908400}{C:81958296253400000000}Kamille!

{C:81938200}{C:81958296273400000000}Are you going to correct me?
But hitting me
won't change how I feel.

{C:81909500}{C:81958296283400000000}Kamille, stop.
If my being here is a burden,
I'll leave the ship.

{C:81908400}{C:81958296293400000000}That would be best.
Cyber-Newtypes are dangerous!

{C:81938200}{C:819582962A3400000000}Lieutenant Quattro!!


{x00}

{C:81938400}{C:819582962B3400000000}Ghh!

{C:81938200}{C:819582962C3400000000}Being an adult doesn't give you the right
to hurt people!!
Excuse me.

{C:81939500}{C:819582962D3400000000}Kamille, are you sure?

{C:81938200}{C:819582962E3400000000}It's all right.
Let's go, Four.


{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81908A00}{C:819582962F3400000000}He got you there, Char.

{C:81908400}{C:81958296303400000000}Can't I make him understand...?

{C:81908A00}{C:81958296313400000000}You won't if you speak like that.
That's why you can't
persuade Sayla either.

{C:81908400}{C:81958296323400000000}Artesia has nothing to do with this.

{C:81908A00}{C:81958296333400000000}If you can't understand that,
you won't be able to persuade Kamille.

{C:81908400}{C:81958296353400000000}Could you do it?

{C:81908A00}{C:81958296363400000000}No...
Even after several years,
I haven't gotten beyond that myself.

{C:81958296373400000000}People's feelings are complicated.

{C:81908400}{C:81958296383400000000}They are...



{x00}

{C:8193A502}{C:81958296CB3300000000}Don't you think
we're fun-and-cool?

{C:81934202}{C:81958296CC3300000000}Fun... and cool?

{C:8193A502}{C:81958296CD3300000000}It means we're fun
and we're cool.

{C:81934202}{C:81958296CE3300000000}Ahahaha, I see.
Himiko and Shibaraku
are both funny, aren't they?

{C:8193A502}{C:81958296CF3300000000}Well, Himiko's a special case.




{x00}
